name: Husky
identity: White-gray shaggy husky with brown ears and ochre patches, thick white facial mask, pointed ears, four paws and a bushy white-tipped tail.
source_observations: Gray-taupe low canine; large white cheek ruff, four white lower paws, round ochre back/hip spots; two pointed ears; full bushy down-curved white-tipped tail. No equipment.
